title: Charterstone
subtitle: The 12-Game Competitive Worker-Placement Legacy Campaign
tagline: Build a thriving pastoral village from the ground up across 12 unlockable legacy games.
loreSummary: The Forever King has selected you and your fellow architects to settle the untamed valley of Greengully. Over the course of 12 progressive games, you will peel building stickers, open numbered secret crates, unlock fresh worker-placement rules, and transform a blank valley into a vibrant, permanent community.
keyFeatures: Competitive 12-game legacy campaign featuring persistent worker-placement engine building
Over 75 unlockable wooden crates containing new cards, rules, and building stickers
Branching narrative guideposts directing the growth and specialization of each charter
Fully replayable as an infinitely customizable worker-placement game after campaign completion

charterstone_full_campaign.name: Full 12-Game Legacy Campaign
charterstone_full_campaign.description: The complete 12-game legacy journey founding the village of Greengully and opening all campaign crates.

charterstone_first_half.name: First Half: Settlement Era (6 Games)
charterstone_first_half.description: Play the opening 6 games establishing basic workshops, guideposts, and early charter specializations.

charterstone_full_plus_post.name: Complete Campaign & Post-Game Eras (16 Games)
charterstone_full_plus_post.description: The entire 12-game legacy campaign plus 4 post-campaign sessions played on your finished custom board.

milestones.title: The Forever King's Blessing

milestones.description: Score ultimate glory across all 12 games, crown the village champion, and unlock a permanent custom worker-placement game.
